This policy covers pickup orders placed through rrdurbar.com or WhatsApp, and catering bookings.
Orders placed on Swiggy or Zomato follow the cancellation and refund policy of that platform.
You can cancel until the outlet starts preparing your food. Please call the outlet or message us on WhatsApp as soon as you can.
Because dishes are cooked fresh to order, we cannot cancel once preparation has started.
Payment today Online payment is not live yet, and you pay at the outlet when you collect your order. So nothing is charged online, and there is nothing to refund if you cancel in time.
If online payment is introduced, this page will be updated first.
If an item is missing, wrong or not up to our standard, please tell the outlet straight away. Where possible, tell us before you leave, and in any case on the same day. A photo helps.
We will replace the item, or refund or credit the amount for the affected item.
When online payment is available, an approved refund goes back to the original payment method. Banks usually take 5 to 7 working days to show it.
The advance, the cancellation window and any deduction are set out in your written catering proposal. Please read it before you confirm.
If you need to change the date, guest count or menu, tell us as early as you can so we can plan supplies and staff.
If we have to cancel because of an outlet closure, power failure or another event we cannot control, we will tell you as soon as possible and refund anything you have paid for that order.
Change of mind after preparation has started, and orders not collected after we tell you they are ready.
Call +91 77020 77999 or message us on WhatsApp . Please have your name and order details ready.

Have your name and order details ready and we will sort it out.
